title: Taiv Ranks #31 on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™
summary: Taiv ranked #31 on the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, its first time on the list, with 2,550% revenue growth from 2022 to 2025.
body_markdown:
For the first time, Taiv has made the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™. We’re proud to share that we ranked #31 on this year’s list of North America’s 500 fastest-growing technology companies, measured by revenue growth from 2022 to 2025.


Taiv grew revenue 2,550% over those three years, more than double the 1,134% average across the list, putting us in the top 7% of all 500 companies.


We’re one of 82 Canadian companies on this year’s list, and we ranked eighth among them. It follows our[#12 ranking on Canada’s Technology Fast 50™](https://www.taiv.tv/blog/taiv-ranks-12-on-deloittes-technology-fast-50-list) earlier this fall, our second year on that list. We share these accomplishments with the Winnipeg and Prairie tech community that’s helped us grow; from the people who’ve joined our team to the partners who’ve backed us locally.


For an ad tech company, this list is a high bar. Most listed companies are based in the U.S. (the largest ad market in the world), and we’re growing above or beside them from a smaller market. We’ve always believed live sports advertising in bars and restaurants was primed to become instrumental in how brands reach fans; this ranking is further validation of that belief.


None of this happened overnight. Over the past few years, we’ve grown our network to thousands of venues across the US and Canada, one market at a time.


We’ve brought on national brands and agencies, made Taiv easier for them to buy, and built targeting around live sports through platforms they already use.


Thank you to everyone who got us here, including our team, venues, brands, agencies and investors who’ve grown with us along the way. We couldn’t be more excited for what comes next.


See the full 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ list →[here](https://www.deloitte.com/content/dam/assets-zone3/us/en/docs/services/deloitte-private/2026/us-fast-500-2026-winner-ranking-list.pdf)


Learn more about the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ program →[here](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/services/deloitte-private/articles/fast-500-awards.html)
